statement.zh: 两个框架都在相同之下确定时，线性检验固定相同；两个框架都有限、步与主张已定时，分支检验固定相同，证明是构造性的。分支检验看得到选择在何时作出。
statement.en: Linear tests fix likeness where both frames are determined up to likeness, and branching tests fix it where both frames are finite with decided steps and claims, by a constructive proof. A branching test sees when a choice is made.

laws.zh: 相同的配置通过同样的检验：从两者出发开放的动作序列相同，每个序列之后能实现的主张相同。
laws.en: Alike configurations pass the same tests: the same courses of moves are open from each, and after each course the same claims can be realized.

laws.zh: 两个框架都在相同之下确定时，同样的检验在一个动作之后保持，并且是一个互模拟，所以配置恰在通过同样的检验时相同；对一个确定的框架也如此。
laws.en: Where both frames are determined up to likeness, passing the same tests survives a move and is a bisimulation, so configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same tests; so too for one determined frame.

laws.zh: 相同的配置通过同样的分支检验；分支检验由主张、失败、合取与“以某动作的某一步可到达某检验成立之处”构成。
laws.en: Alike configurations pass the same branching tests, built from claims, failure, conjunction and that some step by a move leads to where a test holds.

laws.zh: 动作与主张被列出、每个框架的配置被某个列表包含、动作是否一步到达与主张是否实现都已判定时，配置恰在通过同样的分支检验时相同。
laws.en: Where the moves and claims are listed, a list holds the configurations of each frame, and whether a move takes one configuration to another and whether a configuration realizes a claim are decided, configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same branching tests.

laws.zh: 证明的每一步由判定构造：深度 k 的相同已判定；它不成立处，构造一个在一方成立、在另一方不成立的分支检验；深度的相同在某个深度停止细分，在那里它是互模拟。
laws.en: Each step of the proof is built from the decisions: likeness to depth k is decided; where it fails, a branching test holding at one configuration and failing at the other is built; likeness to depth stops refining at some depth, and there it is a bisimulation.

laws.zh: 所以有限、已定的框架的相同已判定，就是每个深度的相同；对每一对只有一个配置、一个动作而没有主张的框架，判定相同就是排中律。
laws.en: So likeness of finite decided frames is decided and is likeness to every depth; asked of every pair of frames with one configuration, one move and no claims, deciding likeness is excluded middle.

laws.zh: 分支检验看得到选择在何时作出：“第一步可到达一个两个动作都可取的配置”在第一步之后选择时成立，在第一步选择时不成立。
laws.en: A branching test sees when a choice is made: that the first move can lead to a configuration where both of two moves can be taken holds where the choice comes after the first move, and fails where it is made at it.

hypotheses.zh: alike_iff_sameTests 以两个框架处处在相同之下确定为条件；没有这个条件，Choosing 给出反例。
hypotheses.en: alike_iff_sameTests takes both frames determined up to likeness everywhere as its condition; without it, Choosing gives a counterexample.

hypotheses.zh: 检验是有限动作序列，可带一个最后的主张；分支检验另有失败、合取与“某一步可到达”。
hypotheses.en: A test is a finite course of moves, possibly followed by one claim; a branching test adds failure, conjunction and what some step by a move can lead to.

hypotheses.zh: alike_iff_sameBranchingTests 以动作与主张被列出、两个框架为 FiniteDecided（某个列表包含每个配置，步与主张已判定）为条件。
hypotheses.en: alike_iff_sameBranchingTests takes the moves and claims listed and both frames FiniteDecided: a list holds every configuration, and whether a move steps and whether a claim is realized are decided.

does_not_show.zh: 证明给出停止细分的某个深度，不给出它的界。
does_not_show.en: The proof gives some depth at which refinement stops, without a bound on it.

does_not_show.zh: 构造性证明用到 FiniteDecided 的判定；它们的必要性对判定相同已表明，对等价本身是开放的。
does_not_show.en: The constructive proof uses the decisions of FiniteDecided; that they are needed is shown for deciding likeness and is open for the equivalence itself.

does_not_show.zh: BranchingTest 与外围的 Test 之间的对应不在这里；桥接中 Alike.same 给出外围一侧由相同到检验的方向。
does_not_show.en: The correspondence of BranchingTest with the periphery's Test is outside this record; in the bridge, Alike.same gives the direction from likeness to the periphery's tests.

detail.zh: Choosing：在第一步之后选择与在第一步选择的两个框架，起点通过同样的检验而不相同（Choosing.sameTests、Choosing.not_alike），后者不确定（Choosing.early_not_determined）。
detail.en: Choosing: frames choosing after and at the first move pass the same tests from their starts and are not alike (Choosing.sameTests, Choosing.not_alike), the second not determined (Choosing.early_not_determined).

detail.zh: OneLoop：一个配置恰在某命题成立时有到自身的一步，它与总有这一步的配置相同恰当该命题成立，所以对每一对这样的框架判定相同即判定每个命题。
detail.en: OneLoop: a configuration stepping to itself exactly where a proposition holds is alike to one that always steps exactly where the proposition holds, so deciding likeness for every such pair decides every proposition.

Author counterreview in the integration note; no independent review yet.

next_delta.zh: 以配置对的数目为深度的相同停止细分之处给出界；经桥接把 BranchingTest 与外围的 Test 对应起来。
next_delta.en: Bound the depth at which likeness to depth stops refining by the number of pairs of configurations, and join BranchingTest to the periphery's Test through the bridge.

correspondence.zh: 读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：检验看不到的是选择在何时作出；有分支时，只有分支的检验看得到。外围中像有限的模型的分支检验固定相同（same_iff_bisimilar，经典），经桥接（branching_bisimulation_iff）与核心的互模拟相连；核心中，在有限、已定的框架上它是构造性的，而对每个有限框架判定相同就是排中律。见整合文档 §98 与 Becoming.Likeness 一节。
correspondence.en: Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): what tests cannot see is when a choice is made; with branching, only tests that branch see it. In the periphery, branching tests fix likeness for image-finite models (same_iff_bisimilar, classically), joined to the core's bisimulation by the bridge (branching_bisimulation_iff); in the core they fix it constructively on finite decided frames, and deciding likeness for every finite frame is excluded middle. See §98 of the integration note and its section on Becoming.Likeness.

detail.zh: 复用 Bisimulation、Alike、Alike.trace、Alike.tests 与 DeterminedAt；给出它的 next_delta 所求的构造性条件。
detail.en: Reuses Bisimulation, Alike, Alike.trace, Alike.tests and DeterminedAt; gives the constructive condition its next_delta asks for.

output.zh: 相同及其在检验与相同之下确定性上的性质。
output.en: Likeness and its properties on tests and determinacy up to likeness.

input.zh: 检验固定相同的条件与反例。
input.en: The condition under which tests fix likeness, and its counterexample.

conditions.zh: 线性检验：两个框架处处在相同之下确定；分支检验：两个框架有限、已定。
conditions.en: Linear tests: both frames determined up to likeness everywhere; branching tests: both frames finite and decided.

detail.zh: 外围中像有限的模型的分支检验恰固定相同（经典）；核心中线性检验在相同之下的确定性之下固定相同，分支检验在有限、已定的框架上构造性地固定相同。
detail.en: In the periphery, branching tests fix likeness exactly for image-finite models (classically); in the core, linear tests fix it under determinacy up to likeness, and branching tests fix it constructively on finite decided frames.

detail.zh: 同一模块 Becoming.Likeness 在相同之下补全以相等陈述的律。
detail.en: The same module, Becoming.Likeness, completes up to likeness the laws stated with equality.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，分支检验固定相同（工作板“Current math core”的 likeness 一行；Becoming.Likeness）：回答本记录的 next_delta。新增规律 3–7：相同的配置通过同样的分支检验；有限、已定的框架上配置恰在通过同样的分支检验时相同（alike_iff_sameBranchingTests），证明由判定构造（AlikeTo、apart_of_not_alikeTo、stops_decreasing）；有限、已定的框架的相同已判定（Alike.decided），而对每个有限框架判定相同即排中律（alike_decided_iff_em）；Choosing.branching_apart 给出看得到选择的检验。标题由“确定之处检验固定相同”改为“固定相同的检验”。同时迁移到 schema 2：主张拆为规律 1–2 与反例；限制中“核心中分支检验没有陈述”被新规律取代，读法与无伦理谓词入通用边界与对应。每句旧文本的去向见迁移对照表 [tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.md)；迁移前的完整记录为 text_versions 末项。Becoming.Likeness 的证明绑定在落地运行后加入。
history.en: 14 October 2026, branching tests fix likeness (the work board's likeness row of Current math core; Becoming.Likeness): answers this record's next_delta. New laws 3–7: alike configurations pass the same branching tests; on finite decided frames configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same branching tests (alike_iff_sameBranchingTests), with a proof built from the decisions (AlikeTo, apart_of_not_alikeTo, stops_decreasing); likeness of finite decided frames is decided (Alike.decided), and deciding it for every finite frame is excluded middle (alike_decided_iff_em); Choosing.branching_apart gives the test that sees the choice. The title changed from “Tests fix likeness where determined” to “Tests that fix likeness”. Migrated to schema 2 at the same time: the claim became laws 1–2 and the counterexample; the limitation that branching tests are not stated in the core is superseded by the new laws; the readings and the absence of ethical predicates went to standard boundaries and the correspondence. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry. Proof bindings for Becoming.Likeness are added after the landing run.
